For the class of recreational-type NPA's with off-road capability the gasoline savings from this viewpoint are the same as for the first viewpoint since the manufacturers' plans for MY 1979, including the likely penalty of the MY 1979 emission standard, produce the same fuel economy as in MY 1976.
The combined fleet savings for both classes would be between 10.7 million gallons and 35 million gallons per year and 107 million gallons and 350 million gallons for the lifetime of the fleet. The annual and lifetime savings in gasoline would be between 0.01 percent and 0.034 percent of total national consumption based on total national consumption per year of 102 billion gallons in 1975.
Reduced usage of steel and cast iron, through the use of lighter six cyliner and V-8 engines by GM is considered likely by the agency. The resulting saving is the difference between the saving from their voluntary plans and that resulting from a likely scenario by which they would meet the standard. The scenario also contemplates a fifty pound weight loss from GM's vehicles.
